entry.name: Mozilla Firefox
entry.verified: SHA512SUMS.asc verified with gpg against the release's KEY (Mozilla Software Releases, primary fpr 14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353); tarball SHA-512 matches SHA512SUMS; geckodriver .tar.gz.asc verified with the same Mozilla release key (subkey 09BEED63F3462A2DFFAB3B875ECB6497C1A20256); shared libs in ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot: distro .debs fetched with apt-get download (hashes checked by apt against the signed InRelease/Packages indexes), unpacked with dpkg -x
entry.notes: driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot, FONTCONFIG_FILE -> ~/ibbrowsers/fonts.conf) then execs the real driver next to it. Newest Firefox that runs here: GTK 3.10 lacks gdk_window_show_window_menu (GTK 3.14), which Firefox 101.0.1+ import; 156.0 tried: 'XPCOMGlueLoad error ... libxul.so: undefined symbol: gdk_window_show_window_menu'. geckodriver 0.37.1 officially targets Firefox >=128 but the smoke passed with 100.0.2. geckodriver: forward with the SAME local port as the remote --port (geckodriver rejects a Host header whose port differs: 'Invalid Host header 127.0.0.1:<otherport>').
